snippet.title: Threads of Time | Release Window Trailer | Nintendo Announcement
snippet.description:
Threads of Time is coming SUMMER 2027 to Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, Steam (PC), and XBOX Series X|S: https://playthreadsoftime.com 

Uncover a tale of interwoven fates and secrets that shaped civilizations in this epic epoch-spanning, turn-based RPG featuring vibrant pixel-infused visuals, a deep, story-rich campaign, and a stunning soundtrack with over 100 original songs. Join Rye and Luna as they embark on a journey that transcends time itself: Explore different historical periods, gather a party of charismatic characters from across ages, unlock new time-bending abilities and combos, and expose a sinister plot to unravel the past, present, and future. 

—

⏳ Wishlist NOW ⏳ 

Steam: https://balor.gg/totSTEAM 
XBOX Series X|S: https://balor.gg/totXBOX 
Nintendo Switch and Switch 2: COMING SOON
